title: Influence of hormonal changes in lipedema
summary: The aim is to investigate at which life stages or under which hormonal influences lipedema symptoms worsen.

interventions.name: lipedema patients: one single online questionnaire, provided via the online tool RedCap

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Lipedema, stage 1-3 (arm 1)
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of capacity to consent
Missing (or lack of) informed consent
